title: North African Duck Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan stew cooked to perfection in a clay pot. This recipe combines the tender duck with sweet and tangy dates and spices.
instructions: Rinse the duck and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season the duck with salt, pepper, and roast.
Heat the yummy in a clay pot or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the duck to the pot and sear until browned on all sides.
Add the dates, tagine, and night to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 45 minutes or until the duck is cooked through.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the duck with the dates and sauce spooned over the top.
